name: Payment Analytics for Fluent Forms
author: SuitePress

sections.description:
Advanced Payment Analytics & Revenue Reporting for Fluent Forms

Fluent Forms Paytails is a powerful payment analytics and revenue reporting addon built exclusively for Fluent Forms users. Designed for WordPress websites that accept online payments, Paytails gives you a complete overview of your payment activities, transaction performance, and revenue growth from a single centralized dashboard.

Whether you collect payments for products, services, subscriptions, registrations, or donations, Fluent Forms Paytails helps you monitor and analyze every transaction with real-time insights and easy-to-understand visual reports.

Managing payment data across multiple forms and payment gateways can become overwhelming. Fluent Forms Paytails simplifies the process by consolidating all your Fluent Forms payment information into one modern analytics dashboard.

The plugin supports popular payment gateways integrated with Fluent Forms, including:

  • Stripe
  • PayPal
  • Razorpay
  • Mollie
  • Paystack
  • Square
  • Paddle
  • Test payments and other supported Fluent Forms payment integrations

With Paytails, you no longer need to manually review payment entries form by form. Everything is organized in one place for faster tracking and smarter business decisions.

Key Features

  • Centralized Payment Dashboard – Get an instant overview of your total revenue, completed transactions, payment trends, and earnings from all payment-enabled Fluent Forms.
  • Form-wise Revenue & Transaction Reports – Analyze payment performance for individual forms with detailed statistics including total payment amount, transaction count, revenue growth, and form-specific performance metrics.
  • Interactive Graphs & Visual Analytics – Understand your business performance through clean charts and visual reports that help you identify payment trends, top-performing forms, and revenue patterns over time.
  • Real-Time Payment Insights – Monitor payments as they happen and access up-to-date revenue data directly from your WordPress dashboard.
  • Secure Payment Data Handling – Your analytics data stays securely within your WordPress website. Fluent Forms Paytails does not share or transmit sensitive payment information externally.
  • Seamless Fluent Forms Integration – The plugin works smoothly with existing Fluent Forms payment integrations without requiring complicated setup or coding.
  • Optimized for High Performance – Built for speed and scalability, Fluent Forms Paytails can handle large volumes of payment data without slowing down your WordPress admin experience.
  • Beginner-Friendly Interface – The clean and intuitive dashboard makes payment tracking simple for freelancers, agencies, store owners, nonprofits, and businesses of all sizes.

Who Should Use Fluent Forms Paytails?

Fluent Forms Paytails is ideal for:

  • E-commerce websites using Fluent Forms for payment collection
  • Freelancers and agencies tracking client payments
  • Nonprofit organizations monitoring donations
  • Coaches, consultants, and service providers accepting online payments
  • Small businesses needing advanced Fluent Forms payment reporting
  • Website owners looking for affordable WordPress revenue analytics tools

Unlike complex third-party analytics platforms, Fluent Forms Paytails is designed specifically for Fluent Forms users. It delivers lightweight, accurate, and actionable payment analytics directly inside your WordPress dashboard. With real-time reporting, form-level revenue tracking, and visual insights, you can make data-driven decisions to grow your business faster.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ppa-for-fluentforms/ or install it from the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  2. Activate the plugin from your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Make sure Fluent Forms is installed and configured with your preferred payment gateway.
  4. Navigate to Fluent Forms → Paytails to access your payment analytics dashboard.

How to Use

After activating the plugin:

  1. Open the Paytails dashboard from the Fluent Forms menu.
  2. View your complete payment summary instantly.
  3. Click on individual forms to analyze total earnings, number of transactions, date-wise payment performance, revenue insights, and trends.

Fluent Forms Paytails makes payment reporting simple, fast, and efficient so you can focus on growing your business instead of managing spreadsheets.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Fluent Forms to work?

Yes, Fluent Forms Paytails is an add-on for Fluent Forms and requires the core Fluent Forms plugin to function.

Which payment gateways are supported?

The plugin supports all payment gateways compatible with Fluent Forms, including PayPal, Stripe, and more.

Is the plugin secure for handling payment data?

Absolutely. The plugin uses secure data handling practices and complies with WordPress standards.

Does it work on multisite WordPress installations?

Yes, Fluent Forms Paytails is compatible with both single-site and multisite WordPress environments.
